description: MRPC BLB baseline non-truncation configuration with truncation sweep over 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13.
notes: The model-side base action is the BLB RL baseline action: all non-truncation fields use their highest selectable action-space scaling-factor settings.

The optimizer-side mode is baseline: Rescale_optimizer uses its static baseline chain/t_new/delta settings instead of deriving a new chain from the max action. This is intentional because the BLB RL baseline is not simply the action-space max vector.
The final_eval preset for this file requires the real Rescale_optimizer in-process invoker, so Rescale_optimizer is called for every candidate instead of silently using the heuristic fallback.
Layer 0 Block 1 output_truncation_k is still forced to null by the BLB action decoder; all other truncation positions use the selected range value.
